correctness.rationale: The weighted isotonic projector has finite affine block-averaging pieces, all of which preserve constants. The weighted edge-step basis computes each piece’s exact variation norm by a single fused-block chord. The largest chord is the mass-coordinate least concave majorant. Every maximizing block is realized by strict descending-block data and a sufficiently small step perturbation; strictly increasing data realize the unit constant. The proof covers the full positive parameter domain and all input pairs, not just finite rational tests. `CHECK.py` reproduced 45,900 exhaustive block-partition norm comparisons, 17,245 two-data inequality checks, 571 attaining pairs, and 720 independent upper-hull comparisons.

value.rationale: The exact, naturally defined nonlinear-projection stability invariant quantifies how heteroscedastic observation masses and spatial regularity weights interact. It gives an if-and-only-if stability design rule, actual extremizers, a linear-time computation of the worst amplification, and a sharp unbounded-instability example on only three coordinates. This supplies a meaningful complete classification beyond a routine inequality for fixed weights; it does not depend on an unsupported downstream application.
